name: Send Anywhere
title: send-anywhere.com
shortDescription: Send Anywhere allows users to easily transfer files across various devices without the need for registrations or installations. It is designed for individuals and businesses needing quick, secure file sharing capabilities. Users can simply drop files onto the platform and share them instantly with a link.
pros: Instant file sharing with a link
Supports various file types and sizes
